title: RNAqueous with TURBO DNA-free and SUPERase-In
author: Daniel J. Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iqzcdx6

steps.title: Prepare Elution Solution
steps.instruction: Place elution solution in a dry bath at 70-80ºC.

steps.title: Resuspend and Lyse Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet using lysis buffer on ice.

substeps.instruction: Place pellet in a 50 mL conical tube on ice.
Add lysis buffer.
Pipette up and down 5 times to resuspend pellet.
While still on ice, add additional lysis buffer.
Pipette up and down 20 times to fully resuspend/lyse pellet.

steps.title: Verify Lysis and Pellet Debris
steps.instruction: Check for lysis and centrifuge to remove unlysed bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate into two 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes on ice.
Aliquot a sample onto a glass slide inside a petri dish (to contain noxious smell) and confirm lysis using a microscope with a cover slip.
Immediately centrifuge both tubes at max speed in a microcentrifuge at 1ºC for 5 min.
If cells were lysed, transfer supernatant into two new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes; otherwise, continue with the same tubes.

steps.title: Mechanical Shearing of Lysate
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a needle to ensure complete lysis.

substeps.instruction: On ice, pass the lysate in each tube 5 times through a 25 gauge needle fitted to an RNAse-free 1 mL syringe.
If cells were not lysed in the previous verification step, pass through the needle an additional time and re-check lysis.

steps.title: Filter RNA from Lysate
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the filter cartridge using ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 64% Ethanol (at room temperature) per tube.
Mix thoroughly by inverting the tubes several times.
Transfer lysate/ethanol mixture from one Eppendorf tube to a single filter cartridge in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec or until the mixture is drawn through the filter.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation process three additional times until all lysate/ethanol mixture from both tubes has been processed.

steps.title: Wash Filter Cartridge
steps.instruction: Wash the bound RNA with specific wash solutions.

substeps.instruction: Add wash solution #1 and centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec.
Add wash solution #2/3 and centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec.
Repeat the wash steps for solution #1 and #2/3.
Centrifuge an additional 30 sec at 15,000 xg to remove residual wash solution #2/3.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the filter using pre-heated elution solution.

substeps.instruction: Place filter cartridge in a new collection tube.
Pipette pre-heated elution solution onto the filter.
Centrifuge at 15,000 xg for 30 sec.
Pipette an additional volume of pre-heated elution solution onto the filter.
Centrifuge at 15,000 xg for 30 sec (final eluate volume should be ~45 uL).

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and prepare dilutions for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Measure concentration on NanoDrop.
Make a 1:5 dilution (2 µl RNA : 8 µl diluent) in a separate tube for PCR/Bioanalyzer.
Take an aliquot of the 1:5 dilution and dilute to 1 ng/µL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer.
If concentration is >240 ng/uL (10 ug / 41.5 uL), dilute an aliquot to 240 ng/uL in 41.5 uL and save the remainder at -80ºC.

steps.title: DNAse Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove contaminating DNA using TURBO DNA-free and SUPERase-In.

substeps.instruction: Add SUPERase-In (at 20 U/µL, final concentration 1 U/µL).
Add 10X TURBO DNAse Buffer.
Incubate at 37ºC for 30 min.

steps.title: Inactivate DNAse and Clean RNA
steps.instruction: Inactivate the DNAse and remove the enzyme beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex DNAse Inactivation Reagent to resuspend.
Add DNAse Inactivation Reagent.
Incubate 5 min at 22-26ºC, flicking to mix 2-3 times.
Centrifuge at max speed for 1.5 min at RT.
Transfer RNA to a fresh tube, pipetting out at an angle and rotating the tube to ensure beads remain on the bottom.
Repeat the centrifugation and transfer 2-3 times until no beads are transferred.

steps.title: Final Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform final NanoDrop measurement and prepare Bioanalyzer sample.

substeps.instruction: Spec on NanoDrop and dilute 1 µL aliquot of RNA to 1 ng/µL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer.
